During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] maintained an '''outpost''' on [[Iceberg Three]], a [[Comet/Legends|comet]] in the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], it became the [[Mission to Iceberg Three|battlefield]] between a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] invasion force led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] and a Republic battle group under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]. Other combatants included the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] [[Spanner (clone trooper)|Spanner]] and [[Joker]].
